description: Splits the four largest generated work items along capability boundaries read from their requirement identities. No requirement, obligation, priority or acceptance condition changes: requirements-compiler scope compile --split refuses a plan that drops, duplicates or moves a requirement out of its parent, splits an execution-DAG task, or breaks a requirement-level dependency. Parts keep their parent's owner (the frozen v4.1.4 file ownership); dependsOn orders the parts so each merges a working increment.
